intl_finance.document: Certification of Finances form plus a bank statement or bank letter dated within the last three months, uploaded through the Applicant Status Page
intl_finance.notes: The page says these documents must reach the Office of Undergraduate Admission 'by the designated deadlines' for the application to be considered complete, but it does not state those dates. International admission review is need-aware. Students applying for need-based aid also need the CSS Profile (Villanova code 2959) and, per the financial assistance office, the Certification of Finances with a supporting bank letter in English and US dollars (source 3). The Form I-20 is issued to enrolling students in the spring before fall enrollment (source 2).

notes: Prompt text is copied from the official 2026-2027 writing supplement page. The page asks for 'about 250 words' and says a few words over or under is fine, so word_limit 250 is a suggested length, not a hard cap. The supplement must differ from the Common App or Coalition essay. The bank-letter sample linked from the first-year page could not be downloaded (HTTP 403), and no exact submission date for the Certification of Finances was found.
